q3_corrected_verdict.text: [eri_hya_gru_ind_review/lotr-q3-r2] Correction to my q3 rework finding: ACCEPT; no object change. Current SHA-256 remains a1e36f594ce70c3457226de35db9b6916ac76eecb77870c129029f22617e1672 (160 words). I reopened the cited Two Towers URL today. The Palantír passage explicitly supports the current narrower claim: lines 2694–2705 Gandalf rides ahead with Peregrin, tells him ‘Shadowfax shall show you his paces,’ Aragorn sets Pippin in Gandalf’s arms, and Shadowfax departs; lines 2710–2717 describe Pippin riding with Gandalf and Shadowfax’s pace. Thus source_links[0] legitimately supports ‘later Shadowfax carries Pippin’; my prior statement wrongly conflated it with their later arrival at Minas Tirith. Other q3 checks still hold: Two Towers lines 1446–1450 supports Shadowfax/Gandalf/Gimli versus Hasufel/Aragorn; Fellowship supports Asfaloth/Glorfindel. No edits or new facts. Preserve initial rework report as superseded only on this point.
